IsCommit runs before Parent and Message in sweepCommit, so a missing or non-commit object is a ReplyRefusedError (exit 2). A git failure stays a plain error. The unit tests and the cmd-level test pin both paths. This resolves a001cc91df69-1 F1.

analyzers.New and ExecRunner.Output now use a non-nil empty slice, so exec no longer inherits the process environment. Tests cover nil and empty environments for both. The callers pass d.environment() (review_sweep.go:40), so production behavior is unchanged. This resolves e7e1de17950c-1 F2.

Mentions is batched at 256 names per `git grep -I -z -o -w -F`. It rejects empty names and names containing a line break up front. It validates every output record (commit prefix, NUL, a name that was asked for, line feed) and deduplicates paths. Tests cover the 257-name split, a path with a space, an empty name list and a malformed answer. This resolves e7e1de17950c-1 F4.

Overlapping-match risk in `-o`: RemovedNames only yields identifiers matching `[A-Za-z_]\w*` (engine/review/sweep.go:27-31). A shorter name cannot hide inside a longer one under -w, so no mention is lost.
sweep.go now skips the Mentions call when no name was removed and reads per-name results from the map. The tests check one batched call and no call for no names.
